description: Home loan amount is capped by the collateral value via the Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio.
Home loan sanction is constrained by the borrower's disposable monthly income via DTI / FOIR.
Home loan principal and interest are amortized and serviced through monthly EMI payments.
Home loans are secured by an equitable or registered mortgage on the acquired residential property.
Credit score is a primary filter during the loan eligibility assessment.
Fixed monthly debt payments (including proposed EMI) cannot exceed the lender's DTI ceiling.
Every customer relationship requires formal KYC verification and ongoing due diligence.
Customer transactions are monitored against suspicious activity patterns and AML rules.
Savings account balances accrue interest calculated according to product rate terms.
Home lending exposes the bank to default risk if borrower repayment capacity falters.
IRACP loan asset classifications (Standard, SMA-0/1/2, NPA) are strictly triggered by days past due (DPD).
Working capital limits for MSMEs are capped at 20% of projected annual sales turnover under Nayak Committee MPBF formula.
Key Fact Statement (KFS) detailing APR and cooling-off terms is mandatory before digital loan contract execution.
Commercial and standby letters of credit operate under the legal rules of ICC UCP 600.
DICGC covers savings, current, and fixed deposits up to a statutory ceiling of ₹5 Lakhs per depositor.
Commercial banks must allocate at least 40% of Adjusted Net Bank Credit (ANBC) to designated priority sectors.
Capital to Risk-Weighted Assets Ratio (CRAR) mandates minimum capital adequacy (9% for banks, 15% for HFCs).
Non-agricultural gold loans are capped at 75% LTV against pure gold weight.
